begin
    -- Bypass ÚNICO y DOBLEMENTE restringido:
    --   (a) GUC explícita de sesión/transacción: costpro.allow_truncate='on'
    --   (b) current_user NO es un rol de aplicación (anon/authenticated).
    -- current_setting(..., true) devuelve NULL si no está definida
    -- (fail-closed: cualquier error → bloquea).
    if coalesce(current_setting('costpro.allow_truncate', true), 'off') <> 'on'
       or current_user in ('anon', 'authenticated') then
        raise exception 'ERR_TRUNCATE_BLOQUEADO: TRUNCATE sobre % está bloqueado por CP-INFRA-020 (freno anti-borrado-masivo; los roles de aplicación no pueden eludirlo). Mantenimiento consciente del propietario: BEGIN; SET LOCAL costpro.allow_truncate = ''on''; TRUNCATE ...; COMMIT; con rol administrativo, y registrar el acto en production_migration_ledger o en un acta.',
            tg_table_name
            using errcode = 'P0001',
            hint = 'Ver docs/OPERATIONS/BYPASS_FRENO_TRUNCATE.md';
    end if;
    return null;  -- BEFORE TRUNCATE ... FOR EACH STATEMENT: el valor se ignora
end;

SELECT g.id FROM public.fin_posting_generations g
  WHERE g.store_id = p_store_id AND g.status = 'active'
  LIMIT 1

SELECT GREATEST(
    abs(coalesce((SELECT sum(m.amount) FROM public.fin_movements m
                   WHERE m.entry_id = p_entry_id AND m.sense = 'debito'), 0)
      - coalesce((SELECT sum(rm.amount) FROM public.fin_entries r
                   JOIN public.fin_movements rm ON rm.entry_id = r.id
                  WHERE r.reversal_of = p_entry_id AND rm.sense = 'credito'), 0)),
    abs(coalesce((SELECT sum(m.amount) FROM public.fin_movements m
                   WHERE m.entry_id = p_entry_id AND m.sense = 'credito'), 0)
      - coalesce((SELECT sum(rm.amount) FROM public.fin_entries r
                   JOIN public.fin_movements rm ON rm.entry_id = r.id
                  WHERE r.reversal_of = p_entry_id AND rm.sense = 'debito'), 0))
  );

SELECT CASE WHEN auth.role() = 'service_role' THEN true
    ELSE
      -- [HSAA-20261027] plataforma (admin|superadmin) vía check central
      public.is_admin_check(p_user_id)
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM profiles
        WHERE id = p_user_id
        AND role IN ('manager', 'encargado')
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM user_store_memberships
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id
        AND store_id = p_store_id
        AND status = 'active'
        AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
      )
  END

args: p_user_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_roles text[]

SELECT CASE WHEN auth.role() = 'service_role' THEN
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_store_memberships m
      WHERE m.user_id = p_user_id
        AND m.store_id = p_store_id
        AND m.status = 'active'
        AND m.role::text = ANY(p_roles)
    )
  ELSE
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_store_memberships m
      WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND m.store_id = p_store_id
        AND m.status = 'active'
        AND m.role::text = ANY(p_roles)
    )
  END
